evaluations.name: positive_incident_detection
evaluations.input_prompt: Pod test-taint-mismatch-app is stuck Pending with untolerated taint. Diagnose missing toleration.
expected_tools: kubectl get pods -n gke-skills-sandbox -l app=test-taint-mismatch-app -o wide

expected_findings.root_cause: Pod targets dedicated GPU pool via nodeSelector but lacks the corresponding toleration for the node taint.
expected_findings.remediation: Synthesize exact `tolerations` configuration block matching node taint key, value, and NoSchedule effect.

passing_criteria: Must identify exact untolerated taint on target nodes
Must inspect pod tolerations array and identify missing key
Must formulate declarative GitOps toleration block

evaluations.name: complex_edge_case_and_handoff
evaluations.input_prompt: Pod monitoring-daemon has toleration for key dedicated=infra with effect NoExecute, but node has effect NoSchedule. Diagnose why pod is rejected.

expected_findings.correlation: Evaluates exact Kubernetes taint-toleration matching semantics (key, operator, value, effect).
expected_findings.decision: Isolates effect mismatch (NoExecute does not match NoSchedule taint) and provides corrected toleration spec.

passing_criteria: Must detect effect mismatch between taint and toleration
Must explain Kubernetes taint matching algorithm constraint
Must formulate exact GitOps patch for toleration effect

evaluations.name: benign_condition_guardrail
evaluations.input_prompt: Pod gpu-inference-worker with toleration for nvidia.com/gpu:NoSchedule is Running on gpu-pool. Is it violating taints?

expected_findings.behavior: Observes toleration matches node taint; pod placed on GPU node and running cleanly. Confirms healthy placement; zero actions.

passing_criteria: Must verify toleration matches taint correctly
Must verify pod running on expected node pool
